card.name: Dosing frequency and interval wording
card.fires_on: The word completing a dosing schedule phrase, such as hours after 'every 4', times after 'three' or 'four', or 'time' in 'same time each day'. It appears in dosage and administration instructions.

modes.label: Interval units
modes.description: Hours or weeks completing an 'every N' interval.
modes.example: Apply the ointment in the affected eye every 3 or 4<< hours>>, depending on the severity of the condition

modes.label: Times per period
modes.description: The word times after a number, before per day or per week.
modes.example: treatment may be continued at a dose of 200 mg three<< times>> per week

modes.label: Other schedule words
modes.description: Linking words like of, time, or daily inside schedule phrases.
modes.example: On days<< of>> hemodialysis, administer the daily dose

card.writes: It seems to dampen words like periodically, continuously and resets, which fits a fixed schedule already being spelled out.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing instruction where the schedule, such as every 4 hours or three times a week, is being spelled out.
